title: NASA announcement of possible life on Mars

tellings.quote: the the NASA just recently announced that they found some sort of life on Mars.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US spy agency that listens in on communications, hired him to talk with aliens, mentions a recent news item in 2025. He says that NASA, the US space agency, had just announced it found some sort of life on Mars. If true, it would be official word that life exists beyond Earth.
